title: Tool-First Voice Agents: Preventing Hallucinated Menu Items, Prices, and Orders with Vapi and n8n
excerpt: A practical architecture for grounding voice ordering in backend menu tools, deterministic pricing, confirmation, and idempotent writes instead of model memory.
seoTitle: Tool-First Voice Agents with Vapi and n8n
seoDescription: Learn how to prevent voice agents from inventing menu items, prices, or orders using Vapi tools, n8n workflows, backend validation, and confirmation states.
author: Anoop Karnik

cover.caption: Conceptual illustration of a tool-first voice workflow using synthetic data.

claimNotes: The implementation is described as a proof of concept, not a production restaurant deployment.
Twelve menu items and twenty-five representative order lines are fixture counts, not customer or usage metrics.
There are no retained production completion-rate, latency, call-volume, revenue, or accuracy measurements.
Prompt and workbook artifacts contained schema and tool-name drift; the article names this as pre-production debt.
Do not publish raw prompts or spreadsheets because they include sample personal data; all examples in the article are synthetic.
